description: Search Bank of Korea ECOS statistic tables — 800+ official Korean economic series across monetary policy, exchange rates, prices, balance of payments, GDP, real estate, household credit, etc. Returns stat_code + Korean name + cycle (A annual / Q quarterly / M monthly / D daily). Use as a directory before ecos_get_series. q is matched substring-wise against the Korean name; pass blank to browse top-N.

q.description: Korean substring to match against stat names. Empty = browse top-N.
